# SGP4 C++ source

`SGP4.cpp` and `SGP4.h` are unmodified files from CelesTrak's
[Fundamentals of Astrodynamics repository](https://github.com/CelesTrak/fundamentals-of-astrodynamics/tree/faa0d45f504e51f9d0b946594c39f18b311ab992/software/cpp/SGP4/SGP4).
Pinned upstream commit: `faa0d45f504e51f9d0b946594c39f18b311ab992`.

Reference: Vallado, D. A., Crawford, P., Hujsak, R., and Kelso, T. S. (2006),
*Revisiting Spacetrack Report #3*, AIAA 2006-6753.
[Original publication and implementation FAQ](https://celestrak.org/publications/AIAA/2006-6753/faq.php).

The original SGP4 C++ code retains its unrestricted terms; the upstream
`NOTICE` is retained alongside the source. No other upstream code is bundled.
